gateway.config_note: provider contracts differ; see preparation reports
gateway.config_template:
model_list:
  - model_name: synthetic
    litellm_params:
      model: openai/synthetic
      api_base: http://127.0.0.1:18764/v1
      api_key: synthetic-loopback-only
      max_retries: 0
      rpm: 16
      tpm: 6000
      max_parallel_requests: 2
router_settings:
  routing_strategy: usage-based-routing-v2
  num_retries: 0
  default_max_parallel_requests: 2
  timeout: 120
  enable_pre_call_checks: true
litellm_settings:
  num_retries: 0
  cache: false
  telemetry: false
  request_timeout: 120
general_settings:
  forward_client_headers_to_llm_api: true
  disable_spend_logs: true
